Method of Attack: using a SonicWall vulnerability to breach networks
breached network via fake browser update
installing malware via ProxyLogon Microsoft Exchange vulnerability
Impacted Systems: Israeli IT company Pionet and its customers including Assuta, Rambam, Hadassah, Budget Car Rental Company, Sonol Fuel Company, Apple importer Idigital, Israel Electric Corporation, Israel Railways
Attack Vector: SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 100 series and Secure Remote Access (SRA) products with end-of-life firmware
Indicators of Compromise: universal decryption key for REvil ransomware attack
